verdict.rationale: Canny documents linking feedback to existing Jira, Linear, and GitHub issues with status sync. It also mentions querying the team's roadmap and a changelog that shows customers their closed feedback was heard, which implies a link to releases. None of the evidence explicitly describes linking requests to Canny roadmap features, initiatives, or release entries. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of linking feedback to roadmap features, any initiative-level linking, explicit linking of requests to changelog releases, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a product-manager, I can link feedback requests to roadmap features, initiatives, and releases

citations.quote: Send feedback to Jira, link it to existing issues, and sync statuses.
Announce what you shipped, show customers you heard them, and turn closed feedback into retention and upgrades.
